branches.title: Text & lines
branches.description: Read the printed words, line edges and highlights. The George Sand clue makes the original line breaks matter.
branches.nextAction: Seek creator-linked evidence that specifies a different source unit, order or reading rule. The declared151 first-chunk/odd/even correction is complete; more arbitrary variants would not establish intent.

branches.title: Mirrors & layout
branches.description: Test reading direction, physical leaves and reflected marks. Keep measured geometry separate from chosen visual coincidences.
branches.nextAction: Reassess readable intermediate-instruction interpretations against the creator clues. Completed mirror checks do not establish the intended page rule.

branches.title: Numbers & typography
branches.description: Inspect printed numbers and letterforms. A key-sized bit string or an unusual typeface is a lead to test, not a solution.
branches.nextAction: Full-glyph support remains inconclusive at inverse-field joins. Seek an original layout witness or explicitly declare a different visible-field model; never replace unresolved contours with readable clipped masks.

branches.title: Sources & provenance
branches.description: Verify creator posts, the correct article and authoritative source material. Missing evidence stays visible as an open question.
branches.nextAction: Find a contents/colophon or publisher witness explicitly placing Funky Upheaval in a numbered, dated issue. Its 115-row model is frozen; this does not identify it as the March 20 BTC target.
